checks.name: Standalone service runtime copies match the canonical source
All five services expose protected Prometheus-format metrics
Concurrent requests preserve separate trace contexts
Invalid incoming trace context is replaced
Malformed JSON returns a traced structured error
Gateway, auth and flight logs share one trace with linked auth spans
Booking and flight reservation spans share a trace and log the booking ID
Every service emits JSON logs without tested credentials, tokens, query values or request bodies
HTTP latency, dependency latency and booking outcomes are measured with bounded route labels
